title: Skytech Dynamischer Strompreis
description: Preis, PV- und Verbrauchsprognose gegen Ist, Speicher, Netzlade-Freigabe und Prognosegüte (SkytechHEMS D-065, Data Insight D-027).

options.content: **Dynamischer Strompreis – Datenerhebung (SkytechHEMS D-065).** Preise, PV- und Verbrauchsprognose schreibt das HEMS über den Vertrag `contract_hems_data_insight`, Ist-Werte zeichnet Data Insight auf. Reine Beobachtung: das HEMS schaltet nichts danach. Abnahme für die Steuerung: mindestens 14 Tage Daten, Verbrauchsprognose (Vortag) im Mittel ±15 % der Tagesenergie, PV in mindestens 80 % der Tag-Slots im p10–p90-Band.

panels.title: Strompreis
panels.description: Endpreis aus dem jüngsten Preislauf je Slot (Vertrag: v_preis). Markierungen: jetzt und Ende des Preishorizonts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT zeit AS "time", preis_eur_kwh * 100 AS "Endpreis"
FROM skytech.v_preis
WHERE $__timeFilter(zeit)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT preis_eur_kwh * 100 AS "Preis jetzt"
FROM skytech.v_preis
WHERE zeit > now() - interval '2 hours' AND zeit <= now() AND bis > now()

panels.title: Günstigster Slot ab jetzt
panels.description: Günstigster bekannter Slot im restlichen Preishorizont.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(zeit AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') || ' · ' ||
       replace(to_char(preis_eur_kwh * 100, 'FM990.00'), '.', ',') || ' ct' AS "Günstigster Slot"
FROM skytech.v_preis
WHERE zeit > now() - interval '2 hours' AND bis > now()
ORDER BY preis_eur_kwh, zeit
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Preise bekannt bis
panels.description: Ende des Preishorizonts. Die Preise für morgen kommen meist am frühen Nachmittag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(max(bis) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI') AS "Preise bis"
FROM skytech.v_preis
WHERE zeit > now() - interval '1 day'

panels.title: PV: Prognose gegen Ist
panels.description: Mittlere Leistung je 15 min. Prognose aktuell = jüngster Lauf; Prognose Vortag = jüngster Lauf, der mindestens 24 h vor dem Slot erstellt wurde, mit p10–p90-Band. Ist = Rolle pv_ist.

targets.rawSql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT zeit, wert FROM skytech.v_prognose_aktuell WHERE art = 'pv' AND $__timeFilter(zeit)
), v AS (
  SELECT zeit, wert, p10, p90 FROM skytech.v_prognose_vortag WHERE art = 'pv' AND $__timeFilter(zeit)
), i AS (
  SELECT zeit, mittel FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min WHERE rolle = 'pv_ist' AND $__timeFilter(zeit)
)
SELECT zeit AS "time",
       a.wert   AS "Prognose aktuell",
       v.wert   AS "Prognose Vortag",
       v.p10    AS "p10 Vortag",
       v.p90    AS "p90 Vortag",
       i.mittel AS "Ist"
FROM a FULL JOIN v USING (zeit) FULL JOIN i USING (zeit)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: PV je Tag: Helios-Vortagsprognose gegen Ist
panels.description: Letzte 14 abgeschlossene Tage: Helios-Tagesprognose für morgen aus dem letzten PV-Lauf vor Mitternacht gegen die gemessene PV-Energie (Rolle pv_ist).

targets.rawSql:
WITH tage AS (
  SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '14 days', date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '1 day', interval '1 day') AS lokal
)
SELECT to_char(t.lokal, 'DD.MM.') AS "Tag",
       (SELECT (l.details ->> 'morgen_kwh')::double precision
          FROM skytech.prognose_lauf l
         WHERE l.art = 'pv' AND l.erstellt < t.lokal AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
           AND l.erstellt >= (t.lokal - interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
         ORDER BY l.erstellt DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Helios Vortag",
       (SELECT sum(r.mittel) * 0.25 / 1000
          FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min r
         WHERE r.rolle = 'pv_ist'
           AND r.zeit >= t.lokal AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
           AND r.zeit < (t.lokal + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS "Ist"
FROM tage t
ORDER BY t.lokal

panels.title: Grundlast: Prognose gegen Ist
panels.description: Verbrauchsprognose profil_v1 des HEMS gegen die Grundlast (hems.grundlast_w = Hausverbrauch ohne HEMS-Verbraucher und eingerechnete Speicher). Prognosen gibt es ab 7 Tagen Grundlast-Historie.

targets.rawSql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT zeit, wert FROM skytech.v_prognose_aktuell WHERE art = 'verbrauch' AND $__timeFilter(zeit)
), v AS (
  SELECT zeit, wert, p10, p90 FROM skytech.v_prognose_vortag WHERE art = 'verbrauch' AND $__timeFilter(zeit)
), i AS (
  SELECT zeit, mittel FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min WHERE rolle = 'grundlast' AND $__timeFilter(zeit)
)
SELECT zeit AS "time",
       a.wert   AS "Prognose aktuell",
       v.wert   AS "Prognose Vortag",
       v.p10    AS "p10 Vortag",
       v.p90    AS "p90 Vortag",
       i.mittel AS "Ist"
FROM a FULL JOIN v USING (zeit) FULL JOIN i USING (zeit)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.zeit AS "time", regexp_replace(s.name, '^HEMS (.*) Ladezustand$', '\1') AS metric, r.mittel AS value
FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min r
JOIN skytech.sensor s ON s.id = r.sensor_id
WHERE r.rolle LIKE 'speicher\_soc:%' AND $__timeFilter(r.zeit)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Nutzbare Energie und Reichweite
panels.description: hems.nutzbar_kwh (über soc_min, nach Entladewirkungsgrad, alle Speicher) und hems.reichweite_h (erwartete Reichweite mit Verbrauchs- und PV-Prognose; fehlt, wenn sie über den Prognosehorizont reicht).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT zeit AS "time",
       CASE rolle WHEN 'nutzbar' THEN 'Nutzbar' ELSE 'Reichweite' END AS metric,
       mittel AS value
FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min
WHERE rolle IN ('nutzbar', 'reichweite') AND $__timeFilter(zeit)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Schalter und Netzlade-Freigabe
panels.description: HA-Helfer (schalter_*) und die vom HEMS berechnete Zulässigkeit (netzladen_zulaessig*). Das HEMS lädt derzeit nie aus dem Netz.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.zeit AS "time", regexp_replace(s.name, '^HEMS ', '') AS metric, r.mittel AS value
FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min r
JOIN skytech.sensor s ON s.id = r.sensor_id
WHERE (r.rolle LIKE 'schalter\_netzladen%' OR r.rolle LIKE 'netzladen\_zulaessig%') AND $__timeFilter(r.zeit)
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tage mit Verbrauchsvergleich
panels.description: Abgeschlossene Tage mit Vortagsprognose und Ist-Grundlast (letzte 30 Tage). Abnahme ab 14.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT art, zeit, wert, p10, p90, ist_rolle FROM skytech.v_prognose_vortag
  WHERE art IN ('pv', 'verbrauch') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), i AS (
  SELECT rolle, zeit, mittel FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min
  WHERE rolle IN ('pv_ist', 'grundlast') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), slots AS (
  SELECT v.art, v.zeit, v.wert, v.p10, v.p90, i.mittel AS ist
  FROM v JOIN i ON i.rolle = v.ist_rolle AND i.zeit = v.zeit
), tage AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', zeit AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS tag, art, count(*) AS slots,
         sum(wert) * 0.25 / 1000 AS prognose_kwh,
         sum(ist) * 0.25 / 1000 AS ist_kwh,
         avg(abs(wert - ist)) AS fehler_w,
         avg(CASE WHEN ist BETWEEN p10 AND p90 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
           FILTER (WHERE p10 IS NOT NULL AND p90 IS NOT NULL) AS im_band
  FROM slots GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT count(*) AS "Tage" FROM tage WHERE art = 'verbrauch'

panels.title: Verbrauch: mittlerer Tagesfehler
panels.description: Mittel über die letzten 14 abgeschlossenen Tage von |Prognose Vortag − Ist| / Ist der Tagesenergie. Ziel: höchstens 15 %.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT art, zeit, wert, p10, p90, ist_rolle FROM skytech.v_prognose_vortag
  WHERE art IN ('pv', 'verbrauch') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '14 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), i AS (
  SELECT rolle, zeit, mittel FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min
  WHERE rolle IN ('pv_ist', 'grundlast') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '14 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), slots AS (
  SELECT v.art, v.zeit, v.wert, v.p10, v.p90, i.mittel AS ist
  FROM v JOIN i ON i.rolle = v.ist_rolle AND i.zeit = v.zeit
), tage AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', zeit AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS tag, art, count(*) AS slots,
         sum(wert) * 0.25 / 1000 AS prognose_kwh,
         sum(ist) * 0.25 / 1000 AS ist_kwh,
         avg(abs(wert - ist)) AS fehler_w,
         avg(CASE WHEN ist BETWEEN p10 AND p90 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
           FILTER (WHERE p10 IS NOT NULL AND p90 IS NOT NULL) AS im_band
  FROM slots GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT avg(abs(prognose_kwh - ist_kwh) / nullif(ist_kwh, 0)) * 100 AS "Fehler" FROM tage WHERE art = 'verbrauch'

panels.title: PV: Tag-Slots im Band
panels.description: Anteil der Tag-Slots der letzten 14 abgeschlossenen Tage, in denen die PV-Ist-Leistung im p10–p90-Band der Vortagsprognose liegt. Nachtslots (Band 0 und Ist unter 50 W) zählen nicht. Ziel: mindestens 80 %.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT art, zeit, wert, p10, p90, ist_rolle FROM skytech.v_prognose_vortag
  WHERE art IN ('pv', 'verbrauch') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '14 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), i AS (
  SELECT rolle, zeit, mittel FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min
  WHERE rolle IN ('pv_ist', 'grundlast') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '14 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), slots AS (
  SELECT v.art, v.zeit, v.wert, v.p10, v.p90, i.mittel AS ist
  FROM v JOIN i ON i.rolle = v.ist_rolle AND i.zeit = v.zeit
), tage AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', zeit AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS tag, art, count(*) AS slots,
         sum(wert) * 0.25 / 1000 AS prognose_kwh,
         sum(ist) * 0.25 / 1000 AS ist_kwh,
         avg(abs(wert - ist)) AS fehler_w,
         avg(CASE WHEN ist BETWEEN p10 AND p90 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
           FILTER (WHERE p10 IS NOT NULL AND p90 IS NOT NULL) AS im_band
  FROM slots GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT avg(CASE WHEN ist BETWEEN p10 AND p90 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Im Band"
FROM slots
WHERE art = 'pv' AND p10 IS NOT NULL AND p90 IS NOT NULL AND (p90 > 0 OR ist > 50)

panels.title: Güte je Tag (Vortagsprognose gegen Ist)
panels.description: Letzte 30 abgeschlossene Tage, gerechnet wie v_prognose_guete_tag. Fehler % = (Prognose − Ist) / Ist der Tagesenergie. Im Band % zählt alle Slots inklusive Nacht.

targets.rawSql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT art, zeit, wert, p10, p90, ist_rolle FROM skytech.v_prognose_vortag
  WHERE art IN ('pv', 'verbrauch') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), i AS (
  SELECT rolle, zeit, mittel FROM skytech.v_hems_rolle_15min
  WHERE rolle IN ('pv_ist', 'grundlast') AND zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '30 days') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), slots AS (
  SELECT v.art, v.zeit, v.wert, v.p10, v.p90, i.mittel AS ist
  FROM v JOIN i ON i.rolle = v.ist_rolle AND i.zeit = v.zeit
), tage AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', zeit AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AS tag, art, count(*) AS slots,
         sum(wert) * 0.25 / 1000 AS prognose_kwh,
         sum(ist) * 0.25 / 1000 AS ist_kwh,
         avg(abs(wert - ist)) AS fehler_w,
         avg(CASE WHEN ist BETWEEN p10 AND p90 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
           FILTER (WHERE p10 IS NOT NULL AND p90 IS NOT NULL) AS im_band
  FROM slots GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT to_char(tag, 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS "Tag",
       CASE art WHEN 'pv' THEN 'PV' ELSE 'Verbrauch' END AS "Art",
       slots AS "Slots",
       round(prognose_kwh::numeric, 1) AS "Prognose kWh",
       round(ist_kwh::numeric, 1) AS "Ist kWh",
       round(((prognose_kwh - ist_kwh) / nullif(ist_kwh, 0) * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Fehler %",
       round((im_band * 100)::numeric, 0) AS "Im Band %",
       round(fehler_w::numeric, 0) AS "Mittlerer Fehler W"
FROM tage
ORDER BY tag DESC, art

panels.title: Was hätte ideales Netzladen gestern gespart?
panels.description: Rückblick, nur Anzeige: Netzbezug gestern (Sensor oben wählen) zu den Preisen des jeweiligen Slots. Ideal: Die teuersten Bezugs-kWh bis zur nutzbaren Speicherenergie wären im günstigsten Slot des Tages aus dem Netz geladen worden (Verlust über den Rundlauf-Wirkungsgrad). Ladeleistung und PV-Überschuss am Tag bleiben unberücksichtigt – eine Obergrenze.

targets.rawSql:
WITH preise AS (
  SELECT zeit, bis, preis_eur_kwh AS preis
  FROM skytech.v_preis
  WHERE zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' - interval '1 hour'
    AND zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), slots AS (
  SELECT m.zeit, greatest(0, $netz_vorzeichen * m.mittel) * 0.25 / 1000 AS kwh, pr.preis
  FROM skytech.messwert_15min m
  JOIN preise pr ON m.zeit >= pr.zeit AND m.zeit < pr.bis
  WHERE m.sensor_id = $netz_sensor
    AND m.zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
    AND m.zeit < date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
), teuer AS (
  SELECT kwh, preis, sum(kwh) OVER (ORDER BY preis DESC, zeit) AS kumuliert FROM slots
), verschoben AS (
  SELECT sum(least(kwh, greatest(0, $speicher_kwh - (kumuliert - kwh)))) AS kwh,
         sum(least(kwh, greatest(0, $speicher_kwh - (kumuliert - kwh))) * preis) AS kosten
  FROM teuer
), billig AS (
  SELECT min(preis) AS preis FROM preise
  WHERE zeit >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') - interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'
)
SELECT (SELECT sum(kwh) FROM slots)          AS "Netzbezug",
       (SELECT sum(kwh * preis) FROM slots)  AS "Bezugskosten",
       v.kwh                                 AS "Verschiebbar",
       greatest(0, v.kosten - v.kwh * b.preis / $wirkungsgrad) AS "Ersparnis"
FROM verschoben v, billig b
